title: Toddler in Cowboy Vest on Rocking Horse, 1957 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A 1957 vintage black-and-white snapshot capturing a cheerful toddler riding a spring-mounted toy rocking horse. The child is dressed in a Western cowboy vest featuring fringe and a star badge, reflecting the massive popularity of Western pop culture and television heroes in mid-century American households. The photograph features deckled edges and has some light flaring and atmospheric exposure typical of period amateur cameras, with a '57' processing stamp visible in the right margin.
